litellm.kept_rule: mode in {chat, completion, responses} AND input_cost_per_token present; image/embedding/rerank/audio modes are priced per image or per second and do not fit the per_token regime
litellm.license_note: MIT for everything outside the enterprise/ directory; this file is at the repository root. Verified against the LICENSE file on 2026-07-29.
litellm.units: USD per token (scaled to USD per 1M in feeds.offering_from_litellm)

models_dev.capability_note: models.dev publishes SUPPORT booleans (tool_call, reasoning, structured_output, attachment), not per-query_category quality. The capability scores in the model YAMLs and in CapabilityMatrix are NOT derivable from it.
models_dev.license_note: MIT, verified via the GitHub licence API against the LICENSE file on the repository's default branch (`dev`, not `main`) on 2026-07-29.

aws_spot_advisor.disposition: Adapter only: ace.fleetfeeds.SpotAdvisorPriors parses an operator-supplied local copy. Not wired into ace.spot yet — see that module's note.
aws_spot_advisor.finding: The endpoint is unauthenticated and returns 200 (34 regions, 1,192 instance types, {'s': savings_pct, 'r': interruption-range index} per pool), but AWS publishes no licence with it; it is site content under the AWS Site Terms, which do not grant redistribution. Same disposition as SkyPilot, for the same reason.

skypilot_catalog.disposition: Adapter only, no vendored bytes: ace.fleetfeeds.SkyPilotCatalog parses an operator-supplied local vms.csv. Tests run against a synthetic fixture we wrote.
skypilot_catalog.finding: skypilot-org/skypilot-catalog has no LICENSE, COPYING or NOTICE file anywhere in its tree (257 paths, checked via the GitHub trees API), and the GitHub licence API reports null. The skypilot-org/skypilot ENGINE repo is Apache-2.0, but that is a separate repository and its licence does not extend here. Unlicensed by default means all rights reserved, so the bytes are not redistributable inside an MIT repo.
skypilot_catalog.verified_facts: Refresh cadence IS documented and is every 7 hours. v1-v8 all resolve, but the README states only v7 and v8 are still updated periodically, so v5/v6 returning 200 is a stale file, not a live one. v8 is the version to use if you use any.
